_note: This file is a Detectron2 configuration module with no callable functions, classes, or CLI entry points. It overrides base config (r50_fpn_100_ep) to add attribute prediction heads for Mask R-CNN using ResNet-50 FPN trained for 100 epochs.
configure_attribute_roi_pooler: configure the ROIAlignV2 pooler for attribute prediction using p2-p5 FPN features with 7x7 output size
configure_attribute_head: configure the FastRCNNConvFCHead for attribute prediction with two 1024-dim fully connected layers
configure_attribute_predictor: configure the AttributeOutputLayers predictor with mapped attribute ID groups and a 0.01 loss weight
configure_dataloader_for_attributes: configure the dataloader to use bitmask mask format with a total batch size of 64 and attribute evaluation enabled
configure_eval_period: configure the training eval period to 3000000 iterations for the attribute-aware Mask R-CNN model
